title: Elevator Service Maintenance Log
subtitle: Elevator Service: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Elevator Service Maintenance Log covers elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing. The building elevator coordinator records Elevator Service events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Elevator Service Maintenance Log keeps Elevator Service exceptions visible until the building elevator coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Elevator Service Maintenance Log at machine space, hoistway access point, car, and affected landings. Document elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing identity before Elevator Service begins. Compare elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing findings with stated Elevator Service criteria; route unresolved Elevator Service issues to licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer. For Elevator Service Maintenance Log, confirm requirements for Elevator Service. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer to review Elevator Service conditions beyond the building elevator coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Elevator Service, identify responsible parties, machine space, hoistway access point, car, and affected landings, and the linked elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing source.

fields.label: Service call, permit, and maintenance-control reference

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture Elevator Service facts for elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Elevator Service tracked controls
items: Leveling, ride, noise, and vibration observation
Alarm, emergency communication, and lighting response
Visible controls, indicators, and operating fixtures
Machine-space housekeeping and accessible component condition

sections.title: Current status outcome and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Elevator Service chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Building Elevator Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Work or testing beyond technician qualification
Test and measurement record within authorized scope
blocks.guidance: Pause Elevator Service when the unit cannot be secured, a life-safety device fails, or required qualified elevator review is unavailable. Retain the available Elevator Service proof and route unresolved elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing scope to building elevator coordinator.
